<entry id="K00345">
<head-word>כּוֹפֶר, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>

<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">כֹּפֶר; כָּפַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>indemnity, fine</italic>; [
<italic>atonement</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> חצי כ' half the assessed fine. Ib. כ' שלם אמר רחמנא וכ' the law (Ex. XXI, 30) speaks of a full indemnity (as an atonement) &c., v. next w.; a. fr.—Treat. Sof’rim XXI, 4 לשם כ' as an obligatory ransom, opp. לשם נדבה.—
<plural-form>Pl. כּוֹפְרִין</plural-form>. B. Kam. l. c. חייבי כ' מאי how is it about seizing the property of those bound to pay indemnities?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00348">
<head-word>כּוּפְרָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (כפר) 
<italic>the inflorescence of palms, a spike covered with numerous flowers, and enveloped by one or more sheathing bracts called spathes</italic> (v. Cyclop. Brit. s. v. Palm, a. Löw Pfl. p. 118); 
<italic>the date-berry in its early stage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 56
<sup>a</sup> מנהי כ' דיכרא וכ' (for fertilization) they put the male flower (scatter the pollen) over the female tree. B. Kam. 59
<sup>b</sup> האי מאן דקץ כ' וכ' if one cuts a date flower what damages has he to pay?—Succ. 32
<sup>a</sup> ואימא כ' perhaps (Lev. XXIII, 40) the spike is meant?—Ber. 36
<sup>b</sup> בכ' in the early stage of the berry.—
<plural-form>Pl. כּוּפְרֵי</plural-form>. Pes. 52
<sup>b</sup> (Ms. M. sing.), v. כָּפְנִי.—Keth. 10
<sup>a</sup> אסבוהו כ', v. סְבָא. [Y. Shebi. II, 34
<sup>a</sup> bot. כופריא, v. next w.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00351">
<head-word>כּוּפְרִי, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>כּוּפְרִית</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of כְּפָר) 
<italic>belonging to the village, wild</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—כלב כ' 
<italic>village dog, ferocious dog</italic>. Tosef. Kil. V, 8 כלב כ' וכ' a 
<italic>Kuf’ri</italic> dog is a species of wild beasts (not a domestic animal). Kil. I, 6 כלב הכ' והשועל וכ' the wild dog and the jackal … are heterogeneous (כלאים). Y. ib. I, 27
<sup>a</sup> bot. (not כופרין). Lam. R. to I, 4; a. e.—בצל כ' wild onion, opp. to ב' בני המדינה townsmen’s (garden) onion. Ned. 26
<sup>b</sup>; 66
<sup>a</sup> הכ' יפה וכ' (Ar. הכּוּפְרִים יפין) the wild onion is good for the heart (stomach); Tosef. ib. V, 1 הכופרין יפה (corr. acc.), opp. בני בצלים (Var. שאר) small onions.—
<plural-form>Pl. כּוּפְרִיִּים, כּוּפְרִים, כּוּפְרִין</plural-form>. Ter. II, 5, v. פוליטיקין. Tosef. B. Kam. VIII, 17. Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 3. Tosef. Ned. l. c.; Ned. l. c., v. supra; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00357">
<head-word>כּוֹפֶת</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (כָּפָה, cmp. מטה כפויה s. v. 
<xref rid="K00601">כָּפָה</xref>) [
<italic>an inverted vessel</italic>,] 
<italic>a low seat, a block with a concave top to sit upon; bolster, stool.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XXII, 9. Tosef. Sabb. XIII (XIV), 17 וכ' חקוק בין כ' (ed. Zuck. כרפ', Var. כיפ', corr. acc.) a block whether caved out &c. Kel. XX, 5 כ' שקבעו וכ' if one put a stool in the rubble of a wall (v. נִדְבָּךְ; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. XI, 6 כסא … בבנין). Tosef. ib. B. Bath. II, 1 [read:] כ' חלקה שאין בה וכ' (v. R. S. to Kel. XXII, 9; ed. Zuck. כיפת חלק) a plain (not shaped) block which has not the height of &c. Y. Pes. VII, 28
<sup>d</sup> bot. בצק שעשאו כ' a mass of hardened dough which one made into a seating block. Ohol. XI, 3 וכ' עבה a thick carpet-cover of a seating block (cmp. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 10). Y. Erub. VII, 24
<sup>b</sup> bot. כ' שהדריגוה a seating block into which steps were cut. Tosef. Ohol. XII, 2 שתי … וכ' ע"ג האבן R. S. to ib. XI, 3 (ed. Zuck. a. oth. וכי') two stones above one another and a seating block on top &c.; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. כּוֹפְתִין</plural-form>. Ib. in R. S. to Ohol l. c. (ed. Zuck. a. oth. כָּפִיתִין).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00361">
<head-word>כְּוֵץ, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּוֵיץ, </head-word>
<head-word>כְּוַוץ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. קָוַץ, גָּוַע) 
<italic>to curl, shrink</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 20
<sup>b</sup> צמר מִכְוַוץ כָּוֵויץ wool (if used as a wick) curls. Nidd. 3
<sup>a</sup> מוך … מכוץ כויץ the lint … shrinks (and leaves room for the blood to pass). Succ. 23
<sup>b</sup> כיון דמייתא כַּוְוצָא when the animal is dead, the body shrinks. Ḥull. 43
<sup>b</sup> כל שחותכו וכויץ that portion of the gullet which shrinks when you cut it. Ib. 46
<sup>b</sup>, v. infra.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כַּוֵּוץ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to shrink</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 19
<sup>a</sup> וכַוְּוצֵיה for he made it shrink (by using too hot water). Ḥull. 46
<sup>b</sup>; 47
<sup>b</sup> [read:] בחמימי לא דמְכַוְּוצֵי not in boiling water, for it causes the lungs to shrink (Ar. ed. Koh. בקרירי לא דכווצא not in cold water, for it will contract, v. טְרַשׁ I).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00362">
<head-word>כּוֹר</head-word>

<italic>a heap</italic>,] 
<italic>Khor</italic>, a measure of capacity, בֵּית כ' (or כ', sub. בית) 
<italic>an area requiring a Khor of seed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 105
<sup>b</sup> כ' זרע a field requiring a 
<italic>Khor</italic> of seed; כ' תבואה a field yielding a 
<italic>Khor</italic> of grain. Ib. ד' סאין לכ' four S’ah of seed for a Beth Khor of land, v. נְפִילָה. B. Bath. VII, 1; 2 בית כ'. Ib. 104
<sup>a</sup> נותן … לכל כ' וכ' we allow a surplus or deficit of seven Kab and a half for each Beth Khor; a. fr.—
<italic>Du.</italic> כּוֹרַיִים, כּוֹרַיִם. Ib.
<sup>b</sup>—Ohol. VIII, 3; Kel. XV, 1 ארבעים סאה בלח שהן כ' ביבש forty S’ah in liquid measure which is equal to two Khor in dry measure.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
